response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering career (15+ years) meeting seniority/experience bar
Some low-level systems experience (DLang, C/C++, async I/O, high-performance micro-services)
Demonstrated ability to mentor, teach, and lead technical workshops
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator, GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or deep-learning workload optimization background
Career trajectory is web/mobile/backend focused, not chip or hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: No deep-learning workload or GPU architecture expertise
Strong general engineering seniority and experience
